media:group.media:title: Speedrunning Nostalgic Games For Charity
media:group.media:description:
Donate here: https://tiltify.com/@eazyspeezy/abta2026 We also made merch this time around, the shirts are $35 and all the profits ($20) will be donated to charity: https://eazyspeezy.com/
Today we're speedrunning some of my favorite nostalgic games to raise money for The American Brain Tumor Association! My mom developed a brain tumor when I was 5 years old and it was a huge part of my family's lives. Thankfully we had a ton of support and this year marks the 20 year anniversary of her being cancer free!
For this stream we'll be speedrunning Slime Rancher, Burrito Bison, Bloons TD5, Duck Life 3, Cuphead, and Plants vs Zombies: Replanted!
The ABTA's mission statement:
"The mission of the American Brain Tumor Association is to advance the understanding and treatment of brain tumors with the goals of improving, extending and, ultimately, saving the lives of those impacted by a brain tumor diagnosis.
We do this through interactions and engagements with brain tumor patients and their families, collaborations with allied groups and organizations, and the funding of brain tumor research."
Learn more about The ABTA here: https://www.abta.org/
